fact: A study by the Botswana University of Agriculture and Natural Resources used Landsat 5 and 8 imagery to map land-use change in 2006 and 2020 in the Dinogeng Agricultural Extension Area, a Ministry of Agriculture ISPAAD farming-programme site in Kgatleng District, to guide land-use planning.
title: Change detection due to ISPAAD Programme using geospatial techniques: A case study of Dinogeng Agricultural Extension Area of Kgatleng District, Botswana
publisher: World Journal of Advanced Engineering Technology and Sciences (Botswana University of Agriculture and Natural Resources)
